## Does it fit the project?

Mind Archive is local-first, privacy-first, provider-agnostic and deliberately
simple. Please confirm your idea:

- [ ] works with no network connection and no account
- [ ] does not send the user's data anywhere by default
- [ ] does not tie the project to one AI provider
- [ ] keeps the user's data in readable, portable files

If it does not fit all four, say why it is still worth doing — that is a real
conversation to have, not a rejection.
